customManagers.description: Update version variables annotated with a '# renovate:' comment in role defaults

prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** update `prom_jmx_exporter_sha256` in `roles/opennms_core/defaults/main.yml` to the new jar's checksum (the release publishes a `jmx_prometheus_javaagent-<version>.jar.sha256` asset).

**Before merging:** update `pyroscope_agent_sha256` in `roles/pyroscope_agent/defaults/main.yml` to the new jar's checksum. Upstream publishes no checksum asset, so take it from the download: `curl -sSL https://github.com/grafana/pyroscope-java/releases/download/v<version>/pyroscope.jar | shasum -a 256`.
